title: Polynomial Features and Validation Curves
learning_objectives: Build polynomial models with PolynomialFeatures in a pipeline
Compute training and validation error for each degree with validation_curve
Recognise underfitting and overfitting in a validation curve
hints: Reshape the feature to a column: `X = np.asarray(x, dtype=float).reshape(-1, 1)`.
`train, val = validation_curve(model, X, y, param_name=..., param_range=degrees, cv=..., scoring=...)`.
MSE per degree is `-scores.mean(axis=1)`; pick the degree with the smallest validation MSE.

failure_feedback.advice: Pick the degree with the smallest mean validation MSE.
Negate the neg_mean_squared_error scores to get MSE.
Use KFold(n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=seed) and include_bias=False.
Return plain floats in the order of degrees.
